integrity: Full analytical argument and standalone finite numerical corroboration; no external independent verification or audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to even 2m rings (m≥3) with alternating ±a detuning and uniform positive nearest-neighbor coupling; only strict linear asymptotic stability modulo global rotation is classified. Does not classify unstable equilibria, basins, or nonlinear stability at thresholds. Previously known alternating branch parametrizations and numerical crossings are credited; priority of an earlier global stability or spectral theorem is not independently certified.
title: Complete stable locking staircase and two critical relaxation laws for an alternating Kuramoto ring
